hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && case "$f" in *.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.mts|*.cjs|*.ts|*.tsx|*.json) node_modules/.bin/eslint --fix --no-warn-ignored "$f";; esac; node_modules/.bin/prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f";; esac; exit 0
